summary: Atomic CLI dedupe-key with occurrence notes

delivery.outcome: Expose atomic CLI dedupe-key create-or-append-note with safe targeted synchronization and protected publication.
nonGoals: File watcher repair owned by ticket-185

architecture.decision: Use the existing store mutation lock for both dedupe lookup and occurrence-note append. CLI resolves the original ticket and its own integration/sprint before sync; existing API behavior stays unchanged without the optional occurrence note.
interfaceChanges: Optional dedupe_note on existing create_ticket_deduplicated Python method
architecture.rollback: Revert protected merge; existing notes remain readable.

validation.evidence: Independent concurrent CLI calls create one ticket and preserve occurrence notes, exact original sprint/routing, no-sync and dry-run, full suite and trusted current head/base publication.
